content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Warangal Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://warangal.dcourts.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Warangal Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Court Warangal Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) recruitment is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) post in the District Court Warangal recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired from Judicial Ministerial service in the category of Senior Superintendent. Preference will be given to those who have worked in Fast Track Courts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this recruitment is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the scrutiny of applications followed by an oral interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 01/2026/RC/WGL.

faq.question: Q10. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Court Warangal.
